temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor at the mutual patient's funeral and hears Shirley say it has been tough, wondering if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knew Shirley cared for the patient and was likely sad, but she had not yet focused on how deeply the loss was affecting Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed by Shirley's visible grief and self-questioning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving strongly, struggling to let go, and possibly wondering whether they could have done more.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathetic, concerned, gentle, and sad for Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley, reassure her that they provided good care, and help her remember the positive moments.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara brings up the patient's treatment and hears Shirley say she feels responsible and wonders if a different approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and struggling to let go, but she had not yet confirmed that Shirley felt personally responsible for the patient's outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley explicitly reveals a sense of responsibility and burden about the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is carrying misplaced guilt about the patient's death and needs help seeing that the decisions were made as well as possible.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and protective toward Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by discussing the treatment decisions and emphasizing that the burden should be shared.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes that Shirley remains reserved and minimally expressive, then confronts her; Shirley admits she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak and says she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving, felt responsible, and had appreciated their earlier conversation, but she now sees Shirley still holding back.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley is deliberately suppressing emotions because she fears being seen as unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs encouragement and a safe, nonjudgmental space to express her feelings, rather than simply being unwilling to open up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, caring, and somewhat worried about Shirley's emotional suppression.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Shirley, reassure her that expressing emotion is healthy among friends, and encourage her to open up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology, saying continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara had begun to worry that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and could have strained their friendship, even though she intended to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley confirms the confrontation felt like a bit much, but she also shows that she accepts Sara's intent, appreciates the apology, and values their ongoing talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship can be mended and that Shirley remains open to support, though Sara should be gentler in how she approaches her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Apologetic, regretful, and then relieved and grateful for Shirley's understanding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To apologize sincerely, mend the friendship, and continue being available for Shirley in whatever way she needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems improved; Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to plan something together for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still healing and that their talks were helping, but she did not yet know how much Shirley had improved or whether Shirley wanted more personal time together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/confirmed; Shirley's improved demeanor and willingness to spend time outside work show that Sara's support has helped and that Shirley is open to a closer friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is doing better, that her support has contributed positively, and that Shirley is receptive to continuing and deepening their connection.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Hopeful, glad, encouraged, and warmly pleased.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and to plan time together outside work as a way to further help and strengthen their friendship.
